photos.desc: A small stream of meltwater flowing down the side of an incline, the moss untouched by humans for hundreds of years
The woolly willow is an upland species, but not dwarf like many of the mountain plants in the genus. The maximum size seems to be about 3 feet high and somewhat more across.
New shoots like fuzzy grey tea roses - an excellent small shrub for damp and heavy soils.
